title: Cedar Walton and the great Messengers and Horace Silver bands
summary: Sam knew Walton from the 125 Club, and he and Ridley praise Blakey's sextet and Silver's band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: And so we lost Bobby too, and then that's when my association with Walton. I've been knowing Walton way back from the 125, 125 Club. Back during those session days.
But see Walton got drafted in the army.

They sent Walton to Germany in the army. So when he came back from the army he had, he had spent about a few years something, and he came back, and then he got involved, he played in a, you know the Messengers.
That good band of uh, Blakey had.
Yeah, hell of a sextet band. See all of those bands, the sextet band, the good bands that was out there. Horace's band was a good band. (Horace Silver)
Blue Mitchell and Junior Cook, them guys they was rough boy.
Boy, them guys, they could really shake a house, boy.
And Art---- the Messengers, they had a helluva band, uh Lee Morgan.
Oh, Lee Morgan, them and Freddy came in later.
Yeah, Freddy came in later see, and then, but Timmons was in the band with Lee Morgan.
But Walton was in there with Freddy.
And uh, and uh the saxophone player.
Wayne Shorter, that was a helluva band there, man.
That was some heavy music there.
